description: Parse a single portlet's XML wire document back into a portlet record and report the reconstructed state as a deterministic dump giving the identifier, class, parameter count, and each parameter as a sorted name/value line. These cases exercise inputs with a single parameter, several parameters supplied out of sorted order, and values carrying XML-escaped characters.

cases.expected_output:
id=sorting
class=com.dotcms.Sort
init_count=3
init.alpha=a
init.mu=m
init.zeta=z

id=escaped
class=com.dotcms.Escaped
init_count=1
init.expr=a < b & c > d
